intent: Apple 官网式现代主义极简：标题中等偏粗、正文细、数字轻盈、极致留白、克制配色，用信息本身形成视觉冲击

type_scale.title: 52–64px at 1024px width, medium-bold weight 600; one or two balanced lines
type_scale.primary_metric: 96–116px, regular weight 400; same visual scale as supporting numbers

layouts.metrics: one clean editorial row per supplied metric (never add rows to fill a template): labels left, values right on shared baselines; emphasize the first by blue ink, not a larger font; no hero number, no icons, no boxes
layouts.timeline: a single strong vertical spine, large dates, alternating whitespace; stages stay in source order
layouts.relationship: asymmetric editorial columns linked by one precise directional line
layouts.quote: one large typographic quote, a small grounded attribution if supplied
layouts.banner: wide editorial strip: left-aligned title, one source-backed focal fact on the right; native Card holds details

mobile_qa: every qualifier and unit readable at 360px
no decorative asset competing with data

typography.cjk: modern humanist/grotesk CJK, Noto Sans SC or Source Han Sans-like
typography.numerals: Inter/Helvetica Neue-like regular numerals; clean open counters
typography.weight_policy: medium-bold title / regular numerals / light-feeling body; never black or ultra-bold
typography.line_height: 1.35–1.5 for Chinese headings and body, natural tracking
typography.background_policy: opaque or transparent is allowed; inspect contrast on intended Card surface
